values.note: Improved campsites (water and electric) $28 a night, $168 a week, $504 a month or $1,600 a season; one rate for everyone (no resident rate). A parking fee of $5 a day or $25 a season applies November through March.

fees.source: https://www.tuscolacounty.org/parks/ (Vanderbilt County Park: 'Improved Campsites (with water and electric) - $28/night, $168/week, $504/month, or $1,600/season'; 'Parking Fee - $5/day or $25/season (November through March)'; page carries the 2026 meeting schedule), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.tuscolacounty.org/parks/ ('The park is open for camping year-round and offers a Park Host ... during the peak season of May through September'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.tuscolacounty.org/parks/ ('along with 20 improved campsites'), read 2026-10-22. The stored 32 (24 improved + 8 rustic) came from note prose; the county names 20 improved sites and no rustic ones.

hookups.source: https://www.tuscolacounty.org/parks/ ('Improved Campsites (with water and electric)'), read 2026-10-22. No amperage stated.

values.note: Rustic restrooms, pavilion, playground, picnic areas with grills, nature trail.

facilities.source: https://www.tuscolacounty.org/parks/ ('The park features a pavilion, playground equipment, picnic areas, grills, rustic restrooms, fire rings and a nature trail'), read 2026-10-22

note: Tuscola County Parks & Rec campground in an 18-acre park on the Saginaw Bay shoreline (8078 Vanderbilt Rd, just outside Quanicassee at M-25 and Bath Road). A park host is on site May through September. --Claude
summary: County page (the park's tab on tuscolacounty.org/parks; no separate park page exists): $28 a night for water/electric sites, one rate for all, year-round camping (confirmed), 20 improved sites (was 32 from note prose), rustic restrooms. Booking method is not on the county page (derived phone/FCFS left alone). Phone (989) 545-7168 matches the county parks contact. Note cleaned (site counts, year-round and booking are in fields; '24 improved + 8 rustic' contradicted by the county's 20).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: entry is 'bayview', but the county says the park 'is located along the Saginaw Bay Shoreline' and 'sits among the shady, rustic shoreline of Saginaw Bay'. It does not say whether campsites are on the water.
Website: the county has no separate page for the park; https://www.tuscolacounty.org/parks/ carries it as the 'Vanderbilt County Park' tab, so the current link stays.
